svg.title: ModelCardRegistry architecture
svg.desc: The ModelCardRegistry singleton resolves a model card from two tiers: built-in cards packaged with llmcore, and user cards under ~/.config/llmcore that override them. Three indexes map provider and model id, aliases, and lowercased ids onto cards.
